body: On the About page of both clients the name is written four times in a row: the heading, the cuneiform sign, the transliteration subtitle, and then the sentence "Tuppu is the Akkadian word for a clay tablet — ...". The sentence no longer repeats the name: it reads "The Akkadian word for a clay tablet — the thing a list was pressed into." in English and the equivalent in the other eight locales, on both clients (about.tagline / about_tagline). Tests: the English text on both clients, and a web test that the tagline does not repeat the name.
title: About page: the description no longer repeats the name a fourth time
